name: pif-adminpanel-mvp
description: PIF Admin Panel — multi-tenant CMS admin panel (React + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
